title: How MPP composes with the other seven
caption: Solid lines are documented links; dotted lines are statements by one side only or the absence of a link. The Mastercard line is Tempo's statement inside Mastercard's 2026-06-10 release; Mastercard's own 2026-10-20 Early Access brief builds Agent Pay for Machines on x402 and names no MPP.
alt: Flowchart. x402 and MPP are linked: exact maps to charge and mppx serves both. MPP's stripe method carries Stripe Shared Payment Tokens, which OpenAI ACP agentic checkout also uses. MPP's card method may add Visa TAP headers and gets tokens from Visa Intelligent Commerce. Dotted: Mastercard Agent Pay for Machines (Tempo says it is working on MPP compatibility; Mastercard's 2026-10-20 brief builds it on x402 and names no MPP), AP2 (complementary, no cross-reference), UCP (no reference), ERC-8004 (discovery draft mentions future on-chain anchoring).
